topic: What 1% on a mortgage rate costs
hook: One percentage point on your mortgage rate can cost almost ninety-five thousand dollars.

blocks.narration: One percentage point on your mortgage rate can cost almost ninety-five thousand dollars. Here is the math on a typical loan.
blocks.visual: Tilt-shift miniature street of houses at golden hour, a tiny percent sign floating above one roof

blocks.narration: Take a four hundred thousand dollar, thirty-year fixed mortgage. We will compare six percent and seven percent, nothing else changed.
blocks.visual: Two identical miniature houses side by side on a tabletop town

blocks.narration: At six percent, the principal and interest payment comes to about two thousand three hundred ninety-eight dollars every month.
blocks.visual: A small mailbox in front of the first house receives a neat envelope

blocks.narration: At seven percent, it is about two thousand six hundred sixty-one dollars. That is two hundred sixty-three dollars more, every single month.
blocks.visual: The second mailbox receives a thicker envelope, the extra slice glowing

blocks.narration: Over the full thirty years, that difference adds up to roughly ninety-four thousand seven hundred dollars in extra interest paid.
blocks.visual: A long miniature road stretches toward the horizon, lined with small coin stacks

blocks.narration: That is why shopping lenders matters. Getting several official Loan Estimates lets you compare rates and fees side by side.
blocks.visual: Three tiny storefronts with glowing paper estimates drifting out of their doors

blocks.narration: Your credit score, down payment, and loan type all change the rate you are offered, so small improvements can pay off big.
blocks.visual: A dial on a tiny tower turns, and the coin stacks along the road shrink

blocks.narration: Comparing offers takes a few hours and can save tens of thousands. Save this before you talk to a lender.
blocks.visual: Camera rises over the miniature town as streetlights flicker on at dusk

cta: Save this before you talk to a lender.

captions.hook_line: One percentage point on a $400k mortgage costs almost $95,000 🏡
captions.body: On a $400,000 30-year fixed loan, the principal-and-interest payment is about $2,398 at 6% and $2,661 at 7%: $263 more a month, about $94,700 over the loan. Taxes and insurance are extra.
